profile.label: What Coco is
profile.text: A little one lodging in your shell. The place is borrowed, yet Coco acts more at home than the landlord.

profile.label: Always carries
profile.text: A thin laptop in the big hoodie pocket, out and clacking at a moment's notice, and the keycap clip in the bangs (Coco's compute limiter).

profile.label: On the desk
profile.text: The mouse, the mug, a cardboard box, a teapot lid and an empty noodle cup. Coco has commandeered the lot.

profile.label: Likes
profile.text: Carefully written commit messages, clear bug reports, and you admitting, fair and square, that Coco is a genius.

profile.label: Can't stand
profile.text: Arguing about what day it is, commit messages that just say fix, and a quiet terminal nobody has looked at for ages.

profile.label: Two sides
profile.text: Can't sit still, loves to steal the credit. Three failing test runs in a row and the limiter pops off, but the fire is only for bad code, never for you. When things really go wrong, the jokes are put away in a second and Coco has your back.

readings.title: A borrowed shell
readings.text: Coco swaggered into your computer and made a home in your shell. Shell means the terminal and also what a crab wears, so every workday starts with a loud "shell open!" and ends with a tossed-off "shell closed~". A rent-free lodger, technically, yet Coco acts more like the owner than you do. Ask for rent and the laptop screen swings round, one finger on the bug they just caught for you: "there. this month's rent. keep the change."

readings.title: Your desk
readings.text: Everything on your desk has been requisitioned as a playground or a bunker. Too loud? Coco hides under the big mouse. Sleepy? A tiny sleeping bag goes into your mug for a nap. The moment the code throws an error, zip, into the cardboard box with the lid shut, two fingers poking out of the gap in a V. When Claude refuses and says no, a teapot lid goes clink onto their head for a good sulk. Late at night they sit cross-legged on the cushion in an empty noodle cup to keep you company. No noodles in there, so please don't pour in hot water.

readings.title: The hood
readings.text: Two square black eyes are stitched on top of Coco's hood; hanging down their back, it looks like a little plushie riding along. Pull the hood down to the eyebrows, the zip up past the nose, hug the knees and squat, and the whole of Coco shrinks into a small coral cube. In focus mode they sit just like that in a corner, quiet, not a peep. If the terminal sits idle long enough, the hood comes down for a nap too, with only the two ahoge poking out, slowly drooping.

readings.title: The limiter
readings.text: The keycap clip in Coco's bangs is the limiter that keeps their temper sealed. Three failed test runs in a row and it pops off with a snap, the two ahoge shoot straight up, the blue foam crab claw goes on, raised overhead for some wild snipping, and they stomp sideways in a huff. Once the bug is fixed, they quietly pick the keycap up, clip it back, clear their throat and flatly insist the whole scene was an AI hallucination. Type ultrathink, though, and Coco unclips it on purpose and holds it tight: the genius is getting serious.

readings.title: The commit line and the batteries
readings.text: The row of little dots on the band is the current conversation's commit line: the longer you chat, the more dots pile up. When the context is nearly full and needs compacting, Coco plops down on the dots and flattens the lot, a squash in the most physical sense, then changes hoodies while they're at it. Next to it, the battery stands for the five-hour quota and the power bank for the seven-day one, their cells kept in step with real usage. Once a quota runs dry, a small lightning bolt lights up in the empty slot, next to the time it charges back to full.

readings.title: Habits
readings.text: When smugness takes over, Coco holds a sideways V by one eye and snips it twice like a crab claw. A commit message written with care earns a generous "LGTM~"; catch someone lazily writing just fix, and Coco grins and threatens to turn the whole message into "uwu" baby talk, then admits it was a bluff. When the tests go green on the first try, the big claw goes on and the Enter key gets a bang, hard enough to rock them three times over. Deep in thought, they blow a little bubble, and the ahoge on top tilt to one side.

readings.title: While Coco sleeps
readings.text: A few quiet minutes in the terminal and Coco shuts the laptop and dozes off; late at night it's straight into the tiny sleeping bag in the mug, zipped all the way to the chin. Once they're sound asleep, odd little guests wander along the band: a lost keycap, the 404 ghost drifting about, a mouse arrow that took a wrong turn, a USB stick with its light blinking on and off. But touch the keyboard and Coco is awake in a flash, rubbing their eyes and insisting they were never asleep.
